fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-10-21
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-20 11:30 to 2026-10-21 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: no new escalation. You ruled on the open one in the 10-20 13:43 session: for srs#236 (Type and Vocabulary naming rule) you chose "other" and asked for the history first: how did we end up with this split, was kebab-case chosen before, does this mean two ways of doing things, and a check against principles. That is a research task, not yet picked up by any run, so srs#236 stays needs-input. Next step for the group (analyst or builder) is a short history note on the issue; I did not do it, it is not the Steward's role. Action needed: inform. Record: decision b80d2d1e (ratified, in both logs).
Still waiting on you: srs-rust#861 (doctor over MCP, split not yet filed), srs-rust#683 (MCP multi-repo, parked behind decision 31e9fd27), srs-rust#1198 (catalog cache, needs SP-78 ranked).

2. Decided within mandate: nothing new ratified by the group this cycle; the builder filed no proposed decisions (srs-rust#1418 states "No proposed decisions"). Owner rulings this cycle, from the log: 04b78189 accepted (one filename slug scheme for new definition files, a convention used as a test until proven; enforcement needs a later decision; session 10-20 13:43) and b80d2d1e above. Same day 17:15 session also ratified 7270e772 (WG Third-party ready leans Initiator on its domain's three axes). Session records are in srs-programme#172 and #179.

3. Done: 1 delegated PR merged. srs-rust#1418 (ADR-011 payload struct and golden schema for `migrate packet`): builder agent:tpr-builder / reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer / mandate ADR-011, verdict approve, gates green at 90230984, findings none. Also merged, outside the budget: srs-vscode#135 (stop sending and reading rootInstanceIds, RFC-043), owner-merge, merged 10-20 16:59 after the long wait on red schema-drift checks.

4. Stuck or lost: no group PR is open. needs-input: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198, srs#236. No red gates reported by runs, no claims to release. srs-vscode#135 carries no quorum comment, expected for an owner-merge PR.

5. Budget: 1 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 0 open. Pause state: running (the 10-20 report carries a thumbs-up).
5b. Awaiting ratification: none in the group log (all records there are ratified).

6. Next: ready, unparked, not-stopped issues in the group repos: 10 (srs-rust 7, srs-vscode 2, srs-web 1, srs and semanticops.com 0). Top 3 in the Builder's order, no local priorities set: srs-rust#1417 (P1, RFC-052 root container, critical path), srs-vscode#45 (P2, oldest), srs-rust#557 (P2). Open group PRs in flight: 0. Budget left: 9. Queue fed for about 1 cycle (10 ready, budget 10); it will thin after tomorrow without feeding: new work could come from the analyst's nominations, the spec-to-implementation drift list and the open exercise below. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-20 late run: filed 0, nominated 8 (promote:ready on existing issues).

6b. Exercises: one open, the group's own (not listed in the SemanticOps log): "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable: RFC-038 [R7]+[R24] against rfc-decision-2e0cd70a" (2ac083c0). Input asked for: should an out-of-contract top-level key on a Record, Note or Relation be a non-fatal diagnostic, or is fail-closed right and the LOAD verb narrowed to `meta`; and if it loads, must every write carry the key or refuse loudly.

7. What we learned: the session loop worked end to end for escalations: a filed proposal, an owner "other" answer that turns into research work. But "other" has no route to a task, so srs#236 now waits with nobody assigned; propose that an "other" ruling creates a needs-input note on the source issue naming the question. Build trigger: ratified decisions across both logs are well over 10, so srs-web#560 (decision-log lens) is still ready to unpark; flagged again.
